description: This file defines a package 'gopathwalk' for walking through Go source directories, handling symbolic links, and filtering directories, primarily used for finding Go packages in GOPATH and GOROOT.

classes.name: Options
classes.description: Controls the behavior of a Walk call, including logging, module cache usage, and concurrency.

classes.name: Root
classes.description: Represents a starting point for walking directories, with a path and type.

classes.name: walker
classes.description: Internal struct managing the state during directory traversal, including concurrency and filtering.

classes.name: symlinkList
classes.description: Linked list node for tracking directories reached via symlinks to prevent cycles.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the walker, setting ignored directories based on options and root type.

methods.name: getIgnoredDirs
methods.description: Reads a .goimportsignore file to determine directories to ignore during scanning.

methods.name: shouldSkipDir
methods.description: Determines whether a directory should be skipped based on ignore list and user callback.

methods.name: walk
methods.description: Recursively walks through directories, handling symlinks, filtering, and concurrency.
